snapshot.text: State-run system with free care in principle but chronic shortages of medicines and equipment. Kim Jong Un has made modernising regional hospitals a top priority, and the 2026 party congress set new public health goals.

priorities.title: Regional hospital construction
priorities.text: New modern hospitals in every county are presented as a 'health revolution'.

priorities.title: Medical cooperation abroad
priorities.text: North Korea is seeking medical cooperation with other countries; Seoul said it would supply equipment if asked.
